encoding: One 6-bit alphabet symbol per source word. Its index 0..63 is that word's length. No plaintext words are stored. Tokenize maximal ASCII letter sequences, removing apostrophes within a word. gp uses longest-match ING|TH|NG|EO|OE|AE|IA|EA|[A-Z] in that order; raw counts letters.
